notes: Document stage describes the exact assessed material. Decision status is recorded separately where verified. Do not infer that an earlier file is the final endorsed revision.

ljovpf.stageNote: Preliminary Community Visioning Statement shared with the SAC; not the completed Planning Framework.

chinatown.stageNote: Assessed PDF is Attachment 7, labelled Draft West Chinatown Planning Framework. City Council adopted that framework on July 29–30, 2026.
chinatown.basis: PDF cover identifies Attachment 7 and draft status; 2026.TE34.17, City Council decision 1, adopts Attachment 7 to the June 18, 2026 report.

picture-mount-dennis.stageNote: December 7, 2021 consultant framework. The January 5, 2022 Community Council decision directed further consultation and refinement before statutory planning instruments were finalized.
picture-mount-dennis.basis: PDF cover gives December 7, 2021. 2022.EY29.2 is titled Consultant's Final Report; decisions 1–3 direct continuing consultation and refinement of findings. Do not equate this framework with the later adopted Mount Dennis Secondary Plan.

mount-dennis-community.stageNote: November 2025 community development action plan, adopted by City Council on December 16–17, 2025.
mount-dennis-community.basis: PDF cover gives November 2025. 2025.EC25.4, Council decision 1, adopts Attachment 1 to the November 18, 2025 report as the community development plan.

st-clair-bathurst.stageNote: Revised February 2026 framework adopted by Toronto and East York Community Council on February 19, 2026 under delegated final authority.
st-clair-bathurst.basis: PDF cover identifies revised Attachment 13 and February 2026. 2026.TE29.15 decision 1 adopts revised Attachment 13; tracking status confirms delegated authority and a final Community Council decision. Do not call this a full City Council adoption.

bloor.stageNote: The assessed file is the May 31, 2021 Report for Action and attachments. City Council endorsed its framework on July 14–16, 2021; a future Official Plan Amendment or Site and Area Specific Policy was a separate phase.
bloor.basis: PDF p. 1 labels it Report for Action and recommends endorsement; 2021.TE26.31, Council decision 1, endorses the framework in Attachments 1–7.

yonge-st-clair.stageNote: The assessed link is the original December 2019 Attachment 4. A revised Attachment 4 was posted on January 7, 2020 before Council endorsed the framework on January 29, 2020. Ratings have not been transferred to the revised document.
yonge-st-clair.basis: PDF cover states December 2019. 2020.TE12.30 lists original Attachment 4 (141418) and January 7 revised Attachment 4 (141600); decision 1 endorses the framework. Avoid labelling the assessed original file as the final endorsed revision without comparing the two files.

port-lands.stageNote: September 2017 planning framework, adopted by City Council at its December 5–8, 2017 meeting.
port-lands.basis: PDF credits page gives September 2017. 2017.PG24.6, Council decision 1, adopts the September 2017 Port Lands Planning Framework.
